Currently this integration initially loads Vike and the Photon server on the ssr environment and calls the rsc environment from there, while @vitejs/plugin-rsc and others do it in the opposite way.

It should be investigated which direction Vike/Photon can/should handle this. Can/should the initial request route to the rsc environment instead? If we follow the direction of others, then Vike and Photon will need changes to support this. Maybe it wouldn't make sense for us to follow others, I don't know. 

An important thing to keep in mind, don't break the user's custom Photon server(main request handler), don't break any imported serverside library (wouldn't routing the initial request to the rsc environment break this?)

Even if we decide to keep the main server/handler on the ssr environment, need to explore how to improve this:
- Load the config modules(like Page) on both ssr and rsc environments(currently handled by these hacky workarounds)
	- https://github.com/nitedani/vike-react-rsc/blob/main/packages/vike-react-rsc/src/integration/getPageElement/getPageElement-server.tsx 
	- https://github.com/nitedani/vike-react-rsc/blob/main/packages/vike-react-rsc/src/plugin/plugins/injectManifestBuild.ts
	

Current flow:

-> Request 
-> [SSR] 
-> Photon server 
-> Vike loads modules on [SSR] (Page, etc..) some modules in the import chain are stripped [here](https://github.com/nitedani/vike-react-rsc/blob/main/packages/vike-react-rsc/src/plugin/plugins/useServerPlugin.ts)
-> Photon middleware 
-> [RSC] 
-> We need to load Page, etc.. here again [getPageElement-server.tsx](https://github.com/nitedani/vike-react-rsc/blob/main/packages/vike-react-rsc/src/integration/getPageElement/getPageElement-server.tsx), the ones loaded in [SSR] are different. Vike doesn't do this for us yet(could it expose some api to do this?). some modules in the import chain are stripped [here](https://github.com/nitedani/vike-react-rsc/blob/main/packages/vike-react-rsc/src/plugin/plugins/useClientPlugin.ts), css import graph is built [here](https://github.com/nitedani/vike-react-rsc/blob/main/packages/vike-react-rsc/src/plugin/plugins/cssTrackerPlugin.ts)
-> Render server components using the modules loaded here
-> [SSR] 
-> Render client components using the modules loaded on [SSR] 
-> Assembly and response
-> Vike loads modules on [CLIENT], some modules are stripped and [RSC] css is injected [here](https://github.com/nitedani/vike-react-rsc/blob/main/packages/vike-react-rsc/src/plugin/plugins/useServerPlugin.ts) and [here](https://github.com/nitedani/vike-react-rsc/blob/main/packages/vike-react-rsc/src/plugin/plugins/serverComponentExclusionPlugin.ts)

Telefunc vs Server Actions
If we support returning RSC elements from [telefunctions](https://telefunc.com), then Server Actions doesn't have any functional benefit over telefunctions?

I'm then inclined to say that Telefunc is "superior" to Server Actions, because I feel like `.telefunc.js` is more explicit than `"use server"`. Feel free to disagree.

Maybe we should still support Server Actions (for RSC libraries?), but we would recommend users to use Telefunc.

Issue: [#48](https://github.com/nitedani/vike-react-rsc/issues/48)

# Tracking: vike-react-rsc's last parity gaps and the upstream fixes it waits on

## TLDR

Tracks what is still open from #9, #19 and #30: the last gaps in parity with vike-react, Next and TanStack Start, and the Vike, @vitejs/plugin-rsc and other upstream fixes that let vike-react-rsc drop a workaround. Decisions so far are kept in a comment on the issue.

## Why it matters

Open items (see the issue for links and detail):
- Experimental flag letting a client component render a `"use server component"` file (#22, from #6).
- Publish to npm (#3).
- `vike dev`: a client package the first page doesn't use is found late, so Vite re-bundles; a MUI page opened second stays blank.
- #30: server components and the HTML hooks share one `pageContext`.
- Vike: `_skipGuardAndData_experimentalRSC` as a function (vikejs/vike#3648), `render(url, reason)` reason lost on client navigation, `throw render()` inside Suspense (vikejs/vike#3726), `pageContext.request`, `AbortError` (vikejs/vike#1707), `after()`, `pageContext.cookies`.
- plugin-rsc: wait for client modules on the first dev request (vitejs/vite-plugin-react#1539).
- universal-middleware#463 and compiled#1960 workarounds wait on upstream.

Read the issue for the full list and the Decisions comment.
EOF

Issue: [#7](https://github.com/nitedani/vike-react-rsc/issues/7)

# Telefunc vs Server Actions

## TLDR

If telefunctions can return RSC elements, Server Actions have no functional benefit over them. brillout leans towards recommending Telefunc (`.telefunc.js` is more explicit than `"use server"`) while possibly still supporting Server Actions for RSC libraries.

## Why it matters

Decides which mutation API vike-react-rsc recommends and supports.
EOF
$q 2026-11-06_publish-to-npm.md 2>/dev/null <<'EOF'
Issue: [#3](https://github.com/nitedani/vike-react-rsc/issues/3)

# Publish vike-react-rsc to npm

## TLDR

npm has only the `vike-react-rsc@0.0.0` placeholder while `main` is at 1.0.0. Users ask how to install it. Publishing is nitedani's call (brillout suggested an experimental release and added them as npm maintainer).

## Why it matters

Without a published package users must link the repo's `packages/vike-react-rsc`. Vike 0.4.270 is out and `main` requires `vike` `>=0.4.269`.
